coverage: Partial coverage from 2026-11-27T07:04:25Z through 2026-11-28T07:06:56Z. Read all nine new GCN Circulars, 46380–46388, on seven events. ATel remained at 18169. Checked public IceCube/AMON and mission notice tables, Swift/BAT GUANO, SVOM VOEvents, H.E.S.S., the GCN revision archive and public GraceDB creation and log records. No retraction was found in the checked records. Incomplete sources include Kafka-only packets, older revisions after the GCN snapshot, older GraceDB logs, Einstein Probe direct alert lists, and KM3NeT, ground gamma-ray and cosmic-ray event ledgers. Exact source times, archive limits and retries are in content-parts/2026-11-28/alerts-audit.json.
